main_text.head: EVENTUS.
main_text.p: Ejus patrocinio dehinc plurimum debuere auctæ promotæque Fœderatorum Belgarum res.
main_text.head: JUDICIUM.
main_text.p: Nemo Principum alacrius, melius aut constantius agit causam, quam qui in ea defendit pariter & agit suam. Inter res itaque infirmas ac ancipites ad talium patrocinia tantum est confugiendum.
main_text.head: DISQVISITIO.

p.i: Quomodo & quando post bella civilia sepulta valere credantur, qua belli & victoria jure à victoribus concessa aliis, aliis erepta sunt.

main_text.head: CASUS XXI.

p.i: Ex Veteri Alexandri Magni Historia deprompta, maximeque in horum temporum bellis Civilibus usus.

main_text.p: CUm Alexander Magnus evertisset Thebas, invenit Tabulas, quibus continebatur, Thebanos C. Talenta Thessalis mutuo dedisse. Thessaliique debebant C. Talenta Thebanis. Alexander in gratiam Thessalorum, quia eorum Commilitio aliquandiu usus erat,

page.notes: Running head and heading "CASUS XXI." read as printed; "Disquisitio" heading set in small capitals in the original. Text on the last line is at the right, followed by "erat,". Scan is slightly faded at the edges; no illegible words were found.
